withheld_reason.contributions: THE RETAINED DOCUMENT HAS NO SCHEDULE A PAGE AT ALL. `pdfinfo` reports Pages: 2, and both were read full-page: p1 is the cover ('2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES') and p2 is the SUMMARY PAGE, located by its printed heading. There is no third page. This is non-existence, not a blank schedule and not an unread one: no 'Subtotal for this page' line, no 'Total Contributions Received' line and no ruled grid exists anywhere in the file. INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION FROM THE DOCUMENT ITSELF: the filing is a FAX, and its own transmission banner numbers the sheets — p1 reads '10/27/2014 3:18 PM FAX 8014651166 HANBY AND ASSOCIATES 0001/0002' and p2 reads '... 3:19 PM ... 0002/0002' — so the fax that reached the Clerk was two pages, and the schedules were never sent. Nothing was lost in acquisition or by the county.
withheld_reason.expenditures: THE RETAINED DOCUMENT HAS NO SCHEDULE B PAGE AT ALL — same evidence as the contributions side: `pdfinfo` Pages: 2 (cover + Summary Page, both read full-page), and the fax's own page counter reads 0001/0002 and 0002/0002, so the two-sheet transmission is what the filer sent.

itemized.notes:
Rob Riding (page-face name; index.csv names NO candidate for this row — the 2008-2018 listing grouped by office), office printed 'SHERIFF', residence city Payson. Report type 'Seven days preceding the General Election', signed 10-27-14, and the amendment question IS answered here — the 'No' box carries a mark (unlike the two other write-in filings in this chunk, which leave it wholly blank). The Political Party field carries a single pen stroke and no party word; nothing is inferred from it.

WHY BOTH SIDES ARE 'no-schedule-page' AND NOT 'empty-schedule': see withheld_reason. 'The filer entered nothing' and 'the page was never filed' are different facts and this is the second one — there is no Schedule A or Schedule B sheet in the document to be blank. A fax page counter printed by the sending machine ('0001/0002', '0002/0002') is a new and unusually strong form of evidence for that state, alongside the `pdfinfo` page count the brief names; it rules out a page dropped in transmission, in the county's scanning, or in this repo's acquisition.

WHAT THE COVER DOES STATE, transcribed but NOT used to manufacture rows: on the p2 Summary Page, Column A ('Total this Period') is EMPTY at lines 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6, and carries a SLASHED ZERO at line 3 (Balance at Beginning) and at line 7 (Balance at Close). Column B ('Year-to-Date Total') carries a large SLASHED ZERO at line 1 and at line 2 — read 0 under the repo zero-glyph ruling. So the filing's own cumulative cells state ZERO contributions and ZERO expenditures year-to-date, which is consistent with there being no schedules to file, but it is a statement on the cover and it does not convert into itemized rows.

THE A3 BLANK-COVER RECOVERY WAS TESTED AND IS NOT AVAILABLE HERE — the B2 limit, and this is a clean second instance of it. Addendum A3 allows a blank Column A to be recovered from summary lines 4 ('From Line 1 Column A') and 6 ('From Line 2 Column A'); on this filing lines 4 and 6 are themselves EMPTY, proven by the 900 dpi crop above, so there is no per-period figure printed anywhere on the document. Nothing was differenced across covers and no figure was synthesized.

The blank Page/of, Last Name and Date of Report header boxes on p2 are a further foliation practice on top of the four Addendum C6 records and the blank-boxes practice seen on 06dd70a9 in this same chunk. Page ordinals locate nothing; both pages here were classified from their own printed headings.
